us.h: Miller takes over as chief of staff
us.s: Stephen Miller became White House chief of staff, drawing criticism from industries that rely on immigrant labor.
Annual inflation is 3.7%, and federal borrowing runs about $2 trillion a year.

us.h: Houston limits police help for ICE
us.s: The mayor directed police to limit cooperation with federal immigration authorities.

us.h: Rubio defends Iran war as necessary
us.s: Rubio said Sunday the war was needed even if it is not widely popular.

us.h: Federal AI safety center left leaderless
us.s: The center has no leader and reports informally to the White House.

world.h: Trump meets Qatar's mediator; no deal in sight
world.s: Trump said Qatar and Saudi Arabia want a peaceful end to the Iran war, though strikes could resume.
Nearly 200 countries opened climate talks in Antalya amid pressure from war and AI power demand.

world.h: No unauthorized ships crossed Hormuz overnight
world.s: Iran says no unauthorized vessels transited the Strait of Hormuz overnight.

world.h: Russia hits Ukraine's power grid again
world.s: The Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant is running on emergency diesel generators after the strike.
A Russian drone hit emergency workers in Komyshuvakha, Ukraine, killing at least 55.
The gunman who killed six in Kraków's Main Market Square died in hospital.

tech.h: Instagram takes AI age checks worldwide
tech.s: Meta is rolling out AI age estimation globally and moving suspected teen accounts into Teen Account protections.

tech.h: Microsoft walks away from Oracle AI deal
tech.s: Microsoft is winding down its 2023 deal to rent AI computing from Oracle.
Morgan Stanley and UBS say the AI stock rout is overdone.

tech.h: Nvidia board probes targeting of its CEO
tech.s: The board opened a probe after reports the CEO was targeted in a Chinese spy operation.
Anthropic agreed to take on about 1.7 gigawatts of gas-generator orders to power its data centers.

talking.s: Pope Leo XIV finished his Uruguay visit and moves on to Argentina.

coming.h: Ukraine–Russia talks open in Abu Dhabi
